reasons.text: About 46% of this county's corn follows corn. Here corn and soybean are a small share of the cropland, so rotations aren't compared.
In years with little rain from April to September, corn yields here tend to be about 7 bu/ac lower.
In years with a wet spring (planting delays), corn yields here tend to be about 6 bu/ac lower.

range_driver.text: What moves this county's corn range the most is spring wetness: from about -8 bu/ac in 2019 to about +2 bu/ac in 2014.
